questions.prompt: How often do you read books?
questions.sampleA1: I read books every day. I like reading.
questions.sampleA2: I read books in the evening. I like story books because they are interesting. Sometimes I read at the weekend.
questions.sampleB1: I try to read books quite often, usually every night before I go to sleep. It helps me to relax. For example, I am reading a detective story right now, and it is very exciting.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, I don't read as much as I'd like to these days. I usually manage to get through a book every couple of weeks, mostly before bed to wind down. When I'm on holiday, though, I tend to binge-read — I can easily polish off a whole novel in a single weekend.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men har kuni kitob o'qiyman. O'qishni yaxshi ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men kitoblarni kechqurun o'qiyman. Menga hikoya kitoblari yoqadi, chunki ular qiziqarli. Ba'zan dam olish kunlarida o'qiyman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men kitob o'qishga tez-tez harakat qilaman, odatda har kecha uxlashdan oldin. Bu menga dam olishga yordam beradi.
Misol uchun, hozir men detektiv hikoya o'qiyapman va u juda hayajonli.
questions.uzSampleB2: Umuman olganda, men kitoblarni jadvalim imkon berganicha tez-tez o'qiyman, bu odatda haftada bir necha marta bo'ladi. Men buni stressli kundan keyin dam olishning ajoyib usuli deb bilaman. Biroq, ish bilan juda band bo'lganimda, uxlab qolishdan oldin faqat bir necha sahifa o'qishga vaqtim bo'lishi mumkin.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - How often do you read books?
idioms: get lost in a book - "kitobga berilib ketmoq"
a bookworm - "kitob qurti (kitobsifat odam)"
can't put it down - "qo'ldan qo'yolmaslik (juda qiziq kitobga nisbatan)"
sentenceStarters: "I am an avid reader, so I typically devour books..." - "Men juda kitobxonman, shuning uchun odatda kitoblarni..."
"Whether it is delving into historical non-fiction or..." - "Yotishdan oldin tarixiy kurgazmali (badiiy bo'lmagan) asarlarga sho'ng'ishmi yoki..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
I am an avid reader, so I typically devour books on a daily basis. It offers me a phenomenal intellectual escape from the mundane routine of everyday life.
Whether it is delving into historical non-fiction before bed or skimming through a gripping thriller during my commute, reading is an indispensable habit I rarely break.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men kitobga juda qiziqaman, shuning uchun odatda har kuni kitob o'qiyman. Bu menga kundalik hayotning zerikarli tartibidan ajoyib intellektual qochish imkoniyatini beradi.

Uxlashdan oldin tarixiy badiiy bo'lmagan asarlarga sho'ng'ish bo'ladimi yoki ishga qatnash paytida hayajonli trillerlarni ko'zdan kechirish bo'ladimi, o'qish men kamdan-kam hollarda buzadigan ajralmas odatdir.

questions.prompt: What is your favourite place in your city?
questions.sampleA1: I like the park. It is big and green.
questions.sampleA2: My favourite place is the central park. It is very beautiful. I go there with my friends on Sunday.
questions.sampleB1: Well, my favourite place is definitely the local park near my house. It's very peaceful and quiet. Actually, I often go there to ride my bike or just walk when I want to relax.
questions.sampleB2: I suppose my favourite spot would have to be the old riverside promenade. The thing is, it's got this really laid-back atmosphere where you can just stroll along and clear your head. I love grabbing a coffee there at sunset and watching the world go by. It never fails to lift my mood.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menga bog' yoqadi. U katta va yashil.
questions.uzSampleA2: Mening eng sevimli joyim - markaziy park. U juda go'zal. Men u yerga do'stlarim bilan yakshanba kuni boraman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Xo'sh, mening eng sevimli joyim, albatta, uyimning yaqinidagi mahalliy bog'. U juda tinch va sokin.
Aslida, men ko'pincha u yerga velosipedda minish yoki shunchaki dam olishni xohlaganimda piyoda yurish uchun boraman.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Agar men bir joyni tanlashim kerak bo'lsa, bu tarixiy eski shahar tumani bo'lardi. Men tosh yotqizilgan ko'chalar bo'ylab sayr qilishni va an'anaviy arxitekturaga qoyil qolishni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Unda shaharning zamonaviy qismlarida topa olmaydigan o'ziga xos joziba bor.
Bundan tashqari, men o'tirib odamlarni kuzatishim mumkin bo'lgan ko'plab shinam kafelar mavjud.

vocabulary.title: Q2 - Favourite place in your city
idioms: recharge my batteries - "quvvatimni tiklab olmoq (hordiq chiqarmoq)"
hustle and bustle - "shovqin-suron (shahar hayoti haqida)"
off the beaten track - "odamlar kam boradigan, chekka joy"
sentenceStarters: "My absolute favourite spot is the sprawling botanical garden..." - "Mening eng sevimli joyim bu keng qamrovli botanika bog'i..."
"Additionally, the vibrant floral displays change seasonally..." - "Bundan tashqari, yorqin gul ko'rgazmalari mavsumiy ravishda o'zgaradi..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
My absolute favourite spot is the sprawling botanical garden situated right in the heart of the city. The sheer tranquil atmosphere there provides a much-needed respite from the urban chaos.
Additionally, the vibrant floral displays change seasonally, ensuring every visit is a visually stimulating experience. It is the perfect place to "recharge my batteries."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Mening eng sevimli joyim shahar markazida joylashgan keng botanika bog'i. U yerdagi mutlaqo sokin muhit shahar shovqinidan juda zarur bo'lgan dam olish imkonini beradi.

Bundan tashqari, yorqin gul ko'rgazmalari mavsumiy ravishda o'zgarib turadi, bu har bir tashrif vizual jihatdan rag'batlantiruvchi tajriba bo'lishini ta'minlaydi. Bu "quvvatni tiklash" uchun eng zo'r joy.

questions.prompt: Do you enjoy trying new food?
questions.sampleA1: Yes, I like new food. It is tasty.
questions.sampleA2: Yes, I enjoy trying new food. Sometimes I go to a Chinese restaurant with my family. It is very delicious.
questions.sampleB1: Actually, yes, I really enjoy it. I think it is exciting to taste dishes from different countries. For instance, last week I tried sushi for the first time, and I loved it.
questions.sampleB2: Definitely, yes. I'd say I'm quite an adventurous eater — I'm always up for sampling something new. Whenever I travel, the first thing I do is track down the local street food. That said, I'm not massively keen on anything too spicy; it tends to be a bit much for me.
questions.uzSampleA1: Ha, menga yangi ovqat yoqadi. U mazali.
questions.uzSampleA2: Ha, men yangi taomlarni tatib ko'rishni yoqtiraman. Ba'zan oilam bilan xitoy restoraniga boraman. U juda mazali.
questions.uzSampleB1: Aslida, ha, menga juda yoqadi. O'ylashimcha, turli mamlakatlardan bo'lgan taomlarni tatib ko'rish juda hayajonli. Misol uchun, o'tgan hafta birinchi marta sushini tatib ko'rdim va u menga juda yoqdi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Albatta! Men yangi taomlarni tatib ko'rish orqali dunyoqarashimni kengaytirish va boshqa madaniyatlar haqida ko'proq bilib olish mumkin deb hisoblayman. An'anaviy sevimli taomlarim bo'lsa-da, ovqatlanish masalasiga kelganda, doimo o'z qulaylik hududimdan chiqishga tayyorman. Shunga qaramay, juda achchiq taomlarning katta muxlisi emasman.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - Do you enjoy trying new food?
idioms: hit the spot - "ayni muddao bo'lmoq (oziq-ovqat haqida)"
not my cup of tea - "menga yoqmaydi (meniki emas)"
make my mouth water - "ishtahamni ochmoq (og'zimning suvini keltirmoq)"
phrases: adventurous eater - "yangi taomlarni tatib ko'rishni yoqtiradigan inson"
sentenceStarters: "Undoubtedly! I consider myself quite an adventurous eater..." - "Shubhasiz! Men o'zimni ancha jasur ovqatxo'r deb hisoblayman..."
"Exploring exotic cuisines allows me to experience the culinary..." - "Ekzotik oshxonalarni o'rganish menga turli madaniyatlarning pazandachilik..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Undoubtedly! I consider myself quite an adventurous eater. Exploring exotic cuisines allows me to experience the culinary heritage of diverse cultures without even leaving my city.
However, while I eagerly sample spicy street food or unusual seafood dishes, I always have my comfort food to fall back on if a new dish doesn't "hit the spot."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Shubhasiz! Men o'zimni ancha sarguzashtli ovqat yeyuvchi deb bilaman. Ekzotik oshxonalarni o'rganish, hatto shahrimni tark etmasdan turib, turli madaniyatlarning kulinar merosini his qilish imkonini beradi.

Biroq, men achchiq ko'cha taomlarini yoki g'ayrioddiy dengiz mahsulotlarini ishtiyoq bilan tatib ko'rsam ham, agar yangi taom "ko'nglimga o'tirmasa", har doim orqaga qaytish uchun o'zimning sevimli taomim bor.

questions.sampleA1: First picture, family outside. They cook food. Second picture, family in kitchen. They cook.
questions.sampleA2: In the first photo, I see a family cooking outside. They look happy. In the second photo, the family is inside a kitchen. They are making dinner together.
questions.sampleB1: Well, the first image shows a family having a picnic and cooking food outside in nature. It looks like a nice, sunny day. On the other hand, the second picture shows a family cooking indoors in their kitchen. Both pictures show families cooking, but the places are different.
questions.sampleB2: So, both pictures show families cooking, but in completely different settings. In the first one, someone is grilling meat — I can see chicken, chops and kebabs — at an outdoor barbecue, while the rest of the family relaxes at a table in the background, bathed in warm sunshine. The second picture, on the other hand, shows a family of four cooking together indoors. They're gathered around the hob with a pot and a pan of vegetables, and everyone looks cheerful and involved. All in all, one feels like a laid-back outing, whereas the other is cosy and homely.
questions.uzSampleA1: Birinchi rasm, oila tashqarida. Ular ovqat pishiryapti. Ikkinchi rasm, oila oshxonada. Ular ovqat pishiryapti.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Birinchi suratda men bir oilani tashqarida ovqat tayyorlayotganini ko'ryapman. Ular baxtli ko'rinadi.
Ikkinchi suratda oila oshxonaning ichida. Ular birgalikda kechki ovqat tayyorlashmoqda.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Xo'sh, birinchi rasmda bir oila tabiatda piknik qilib, ovqat tayyorlayotganini ko'rsatadi. Ob-havo yaxshi, quyoshli kun ekanligi ko'rinib turibdi.
Boshqa tomondan, ikkinchi rasmda bir oila o'z oshxonasida ovqat tayyorlayotganini ko'rsatadi. Ikkala rasmda ham oilalar ovqat tayyorlayapti, lekin joylar har xil.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Bu ikki rasm oilalarning birgalikda ovqat tayyorlashning turli usullarini ko'rsatadi. Birinchi rasm ochiq havoda oilaning barbekyu qilayotganini yoki piknik pechkasida ovqat pishirayotganini aks ettiradi, bu dam olish faoliyati yoki ta'tilni anglatadi.
Aksincha, ikkinchi surat yopiq muhitni, xususan zamonaviy oshxonani ko'rsatadi. Bu yerda oila o'zlarining kundalik ovqat tayyorlash odatlarida band bo'lib ko'rinadi. Shunday qilib, asosiy faoliyat - oila sifatida ovqat pishirish - bir xil bo'lsa-da, kontekst va atmosfera juda farq qiladi.

vocabulary.title: Q4 - Describe the images
idioms: the great outdoors - "tabiat qo'ynida"
home sweet home - "o'z uyim, o'lan to'shagim"
a breath of fresh air - "toza havo (yangi va yoqimli o'zgarish)"
sentenceStarters: "The first picture portrays a delightful scene of a family enjoying..." - "Birinchi rasmda oilaning... zavqlanayotgan ajoyib manzarasi tasvirlangan."
"In stark contrast, the second image depicts a family preparing..." - "Bunga butunlay qarama-qarshi o'laroq, ikkinchi rasmda oilaning..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
The first picture portrays a delightful scene of a family enjoying a picnic and cooking outdoors, possibly in a forest or park. The relaxed ambiance suggests they are embracing nature and spending quality time together.
In stark contrast, the second image depicts a family preparing a meal inside a modern, well-equipped kitchen. It highlights a more structured, domestic routine. While both show families bonding over food, the settings are completely different.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi rasmda oilaning tabiat qo'ynida, ehtimol o'rmonda yoki parkda piknik qilayotgani va ovqat tayyorlayotgani tasvirlangan ajoyib manzara aks etgan. Erkin muhit ularning tabiatni qabul qilayotganini va birgalikda sifatli vaqt o'tkazayotganini ko'rsatadi.

Keskin farq sifatida, ikkinchi rasmda oilaning zamonaviy, yaxshi jihozlangan oshxonada ovqat tayyorlayotgani tasvirlangan. Bu ko'proq tuzilgan, uy sharoitidagi tartibni ta'kidlaydi. Ikkala rasm ham oilalarning ovqat ustida birlashayotganini ko'rsatsa-da, muhit butunlay boshqacha.

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of cooking outdoors?
questions.sampleA1: Cooking outside is good. Fresh air is nice. Food is tasty.
questions.sampleA2: I think cooking outdoors is fun. You can enjoy the fresh air and sun. Also, the food, like barbecue, tastes very good.
questions.sampleB1: There are a few benefits to cooking outside. First of all, it is very relaxing to be in nature and breathe fresh air. Also, it's a great social activity. Families and friends can gather around and talk while the food is cooking. It's much more engaging than cooking alone in a small kitchen.
questions.sampleB2: Well, the biggest benefit for me is that it gets everyone out into the fresh air, which is a real breath of fresh air after being cooped up indoors. On top of that, food cooked over a fire just tastes better — it picks up that lovely smoky flavour. And honestly, it turns a boring chore into a proper social occasion.
questions.uzSampleA1: Ochiq havoda ovqat pishirish yaxshi. Toza havo yoqimli. Ovqat mazali bo'ladi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menimcha, tashqarida ovqat pishirish qiziqarli. Siz toza havo va quyoshdan bahramand bo'lishingiz mumkin. Bundan tashqari, barbekyu kabi ovqatlar juda mazali bo'ladi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Ochiq havoda ovqat pishirishning bir nechta afzalliklari bor. Avvalo, tabiatda bo'lish va toza havodan nafas olish juda yoqimli.
Qolaversa, bu ajoyib ijtimoiy faoliyat. Oilalar va do'stlar yig'ilib, ovqat pishayotgan paytda suhbatlashishlari mumkin. Bu kichkina oshxonada yolg'iz ovqat pishirishdan ko'ra ancha qiziqarliroq.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Ochiq havoda ovqat pishirish bir qancha sezilarli afzalliklarni taqdim etadi.
Avvalo, bu uyning chegaralaridan qochib, tabiiy muhitdan bahramand bo'lish uchun ajoyib imkoniyat yaratadi, bu esa stressni kamaytirish uchun juda yaxshi.
Bundan tashqari, grilda pishirish kabi usullar ovqatga ko'pchilikka yoqadigan o'ziga xos ta'm beradi.
Va nihoyat, u ovqat pishirish majburiyatini bayramona, jamoaviy faoliyatga aylantiradi, bu esa oila a'zolari yoki do'stlar ovqat tayyorlashda hamkorlik qilganda ularning o'rtasidagi aloqalarni mustahkamlaydi.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - Benefits of cooking outdoors
idioms: live in the moment - "ayni dam bilan yashamoq (hozirgi vaqtdan zavqlanmoq)"
clear one's head - "miyani tozalash (stressdan xalos bo'lish)"
change of scenery - "muhitni o'zgartirish"
sentenceStarters: "Cooking outdoors provides a highly refreshing break from..." - "Ochiq havoda ovqat pishirish bizning odatiy yopiq muhitdagi yumushlarimizdan..."

"Moreover, outdoor cooking often involves barbecuing or grilling, which imparts a..." - "Bundan tashqari, ochiq havoda pishirish ko'pincha barbekyu yoki grilda pishirishni o'z ichiga oladi, bu esa..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Cooking outdoors provides a highly refreshing break from our usual indoor routines. Primarily, the very act of being surrounded by nature can dramatically lower stress levels and boost mental well-being. The fresh air and sunshine certainly make the experience more invigorating.
Moreover, outdoor cooking often involves barbecuing or grilling, which imparts a distinctive smoky flavour to the food that is hard to replicate on a conventional stove. It turns meal preparation into an interactive social event rather than a solitary chore.
Ultimately, it encourages families and friends to disconnect from technology and "live in the moment."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ochiq havoda ovqat pishirish bizning odatiy uy ichidagi tartibimizdan juda tetiklantiruvchi tanaffusni ta'minlaydi. Asosan, tabiat bilan o'ralgan bo'lishning o'zi stress darajasini keskin pasaytirishi va ruhiy farovonlikni oshirishi mumkin. Toza havo va quyosh nuri, albatta, tajribani yanada tetiklantiradi.

Bundan tashqari, ochiq havoda ovqat pishirish ko'pincha barbekyu yoki grilda pishirishni o'z ichiga oladi, bu esa oddiy gaz plitasida takrorlash qiyin bo'lgan o'ziga xos dudlangan ta'mni beradi. Bu ovqat tayyorlashni yolg'iz zerikarli ishdan ko'ra, interaktiv ijtimoiy tadbirga aylantiradi.

Oxir oqibat, bu oilalar va do'stlarni texnologiyadan uzilishga va "hozirgi lahzada yashashga" undaydi.

questions.prompt: Why do some people still prefer cooking indoors?
questions.sampleA1: Indoor cooking is easy. Kitchen has everything. No rain inside.
questions.sampleA2: Many people like cooking inside because it is easy. They have all their tools in the kitchen. Also, inside it is warm and there are no bugs.
questions.sampleB1: I think people prefer cooking indoors because it is much more convenient. For example, in a kitchen, you have a fridge, an oven, and running water right next to you. Also, you don't have to worry about bad weather. If it rains, you can still cook easily inside.
questions.sampleB2: I think it mainly comes down to convenience. In a kitchen you've got everything at your fingertips — the oven, the fridge, running water — so it's far quicker to knock a meal together. Plus, you're sheltered from the weather. Let's face it, nobody wants to be flipping burgers in the pouring rain, so indoors just makes more sense day to day.
questions.uzSampleA1: Uyda ovqat pishirish oson. Oshxonada hamma narsa bor. Ichkarida yomg'ir yo'q.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Ko'p odamlarga uyda ovqat pishirish yoqadi, chunki bu oson. Ularning barcha asboblari oshxonada bor.
Qolaversa, uy ichi iliq va hasharotlar yo'q.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, odamlar uyda ovqat pishirishni afzal ko'rishadi, chunki bu ancha qulayroq.
Masalan, oshxonada sizning yoningizda muzlatgich, pech va oqar suv bor.
Shuningdek, yomon ob-havo haqida tashvishlanishingizga hojat yo'q. Agar yomg'ir yog'sa ham, siz bemalol ichkarida ovqat pishirishingiz mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Oshxonada ovqat pishirishga bo'lgan qiziqish asosan qulaylik va nazorat bilan bog'liq.
Birinchidan, oshxona turli xil jihozlar, masalliqlar va sanitariya tozalash vositalariga tezkor kirishni ta'minlaydi, bu esa butun ovqat pishirish jarayonini soddalashtiradi.
Ikkinchidan, yopiq muhit elementlardan butunlay himoyalangan. Siz oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan yomg'ir, kuchli shamol yoki bezovta qiluvchi hasharotlarga qaram emassiz. Shuning uchun, kundalik ovqatlar uchun oshxonaning ishonchliligi ancha amaliyroqdir.

vocabulary.title: Q6 - Preferring to cook indoors
idioms: creature comforts - "uyning qulayliklari (issiq joy, yumshoq o'rin va hk)"
at one's fingertips - "qo'l ostida (oson foydalanish uchun tayyor)"
rain or shine - "yomg'irmi-quyoshmi (ob-havodan qat'i nazar)"
sentenceStarters: "Despite the charm of picnics, cooking indoors remains the preference due to..." - "Pikniklarning jozibasiga qaramay, bino ichida pishirish ko'pchilik uchun afzalroq bo'lib qoladi, chunki..."
"First and foremost, a modern kitchen is equipped with..." - "Barchasidan oldin shuni aytish kerakki, zamonaviy oshxona... bilan jihozlangan"

questions.sampleAnswer:
Despite the charm of picnics, cooking indoors remains the preference for many due to its unbeatable convenience. First and foremost, a modern kitchen is equipped with all necessary appliances and utensils readily available, making the process far more efficient and organized.
Furthermore, indoor cooking provides a controlled environment. People don't have to worry about unpredictable weather conditions, like sudden rain or extreme heat, ruining their meal. It also eliminates the hassle of dealing with insects or wind.
In essence, for daily sustenance, the practicality and hygiene of a kitchen consistently outweigh the novelty of outdoor grilling.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Sayr qilishning jozibasiga qaramay, ko'pchilik uchun uyda ovqat pishirish afzalroq bo'lib qolmoqda, chunki bu juda qulaydir. Avvalo, zamonaviy oshxona barcha zarur jihozlar va anjomlar bilan ta'minlangan bo'lib, ular doimo qo'l ostida bo'ladi, bu jarayonni ancha samarali va tartibli qiladi.

Bundan tashqari, uyda ovqat pishirish nazorat qilinadigan muhitni ta'minlaydi. Odamlar to'satdan yomg'ir yoki haddan tashqari issiqlik kabi kutilmagan ob-havo sharoitlari ovqatini buzishi haqida tashvishlanishlari shart emas. Shuningdek, u hasharotlar yoki shamol bilan kurashish tashvishini yo'q qiladi.

Aslida, kundalik ehtiyojlar uchun oshxonaning amaliyligi va gigienasi doimiy ravishda ochiq havoda grilda pishirishning yangiligidan ustun turadi.

questions.prompt: Can you describe a friend you trust a lot?
questions.sampleA1: My friend is Ali. He is good. I trust him. Good friend helps you. Trust is important because we tell secrets.
questions.sampleA2: I have a good friend named Ali. He is very kind and he always listens to me. A good friend must be honest. Trust is important so we can be happy together and share our problems.
questions.sampleB1: A friend I really trust is my classmate. I trust him because he never tells my secrets to other people. I think a good friend should be honest and helpful. Furthermore, trust is essential because if you don't trust someone, you cannot be close friends with them. Trust makes the friendship strong.
questions.sampleB2: I'd like to talk about my closest friend, Jasur, who I've known since we were kids. The thing is, we grew up on the same street, so we go back a really long way. What makes him someone I trust so completely is that he's incredibly dependable — if he says he'll be there for me, he always follows through, no matter what. I've told him things I wouldn't dream of telling anyone else, and I know for a fact they'll never go any further. As for the qualities that make a good friend, I'd say loyalty comes top of the list. A fair-weather friend will disappear the moment things get tough, whereas a genuine one will stick by you through thick and thin. On top of that, I really value someone who's a good listener and doesn't jump to conclusions or judge you. A bit of a sense of humour goes a long way too, because being able to have a laugh together makes even the hardest days more bearable. When it comes to why trust matters, to my mind it's the glue that holds any friendship together. Without it, you're always second-guessing the other person and holding back, so the relationship never really takes off. Trust lets you open up and be yourself, warts and all. At the end of the day, having someone you can lean on, who's got your back no matter what, is genuinely priceless — you simply can't put a price on it — and that's exactly what Jasur is to me.
questions.uzSampleA1: Mening do'stim Ali. U yaxshi. Men unga ishonaman. Yaxshi do'st sizga yordam beradi. Ishonch muhim, chunki biz sirlarni aytamiz.
questions.uzSampleA2: Mening Alisher ismli yaxshi do'stim bor. U juda mehribon va u har doim meni tinglaydi. Yaxshi do'st halol bo'lishi kerak. Ishonch muhim, shuning uchun biz birga baxtli bo'lishimiz va muammolarimizni baham ko'rishimiz mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men juda ishonadigan do'stim - sinfdoshim. Men unga ishonaman, chunki u hech qachon mening sirlarimni boshqa odamlarga aytmaydi. Menimcha, yaxshi do'st halol va yordam beruvchi bo'lishi kerak.
Qolaversa, ishonch juda muhim, chunki agar siz kimdirga ishonmasangiz, u bilan yaqin do'st bo'la olmaysiz. Ishonch do'stlikni mustahkam qiladi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Men universitetdagi yaqin do'stimni tasvirlab bermoqchiman. Uning ishonchli ekanligining sababi uning izchilligi va halolligidir. Agar u biror narsa qilishga va'da bersa, u har doim uni bajaradi. Sifatlar haqida gapiradigan bo'lsak, menimcha, hamdardlik va sadoqat yaxshi do'st uchun eng muhimdir. bulletPoints: Can you describe a friend you trust a lot?
What qualities make a good friend?
Why is trust important in friendships?
questions.sampleAnswer:
A friend I trust a lot:
I would like to talk about my best friend, Rustam. We have known each other since high school, and over the years, he has proven to be exceptionally reliable. Whenever I face a crisis, he is the first person I confide in because he listens without any judgmental prejudice. I know for a fact that my secrets are entirely safe with him.
What qualities make a good friend:
In my view, the cardinal qualities of a steadfast friend are loyalty and emotional intelligence. A superficial friend might only be around during good times, but a genuine friend demonstrates unwavering support during hardships. Besides honesty, a good sense of humour is also vitally important to lighten up difficult situations.
Why trust is important in friendships:
Trust is undeniably the fundamental bedrock of any meaningful relationship. Without it, a friendship is merely an acquaintance. Trust fosters vulnerability, allowing individuals to share their deepest fears and aspirations without the fear of betrayal. Essentially, it creates a "safe haven," providing profound psychological security in an unpredictable world.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men ishonadigan do'stim haqida:
Men eng yaqin do'stim Rustam haqida gapirmoqchiman. Biz uni o'rta maktabdan beri bilamiz va yillar davomida u o'zini juda ishonchli ekanligini isbotladi. Men har qanday inqirozga duch kelganimda, u birinchi bo'lib sirlarimni aytadigan odam, chunki u hech qanday hukm qiluvchi xurofotlarsiz tinglaydi. Men bilaman, mening sirlarim u bilan butunlay xavfsiz.
Yaxshi do'stni nima fazilatlar yaxshi qiladi:
Mening fikrimcha, sodiq do'stning asosiy fazilatlari sadoqat va hissiy intellektdir. Yuzaki do'st faqat yaxshi paytlarda yoningizda bo'lishi mumkin, ammo haqiqiy do'st qiyinchiliklarda qat'iy qo'llab-quvvatlashni namoyish etadi. Halollikdan tashqari, yaxshi hazil tuyg'usi ham qiyin vaziyatlarni yengillashtirish uchun juda muhimdir.
Nima uchun do'stlikda ishonch muhim:
Ishonch, shubhasiz, har qanday mazmunli munosabatlarning asosiy poydevoridir. Usiz do'stlik shunchaki tanishuvdir. Ishonch zaiflikni kuchaytiradi, bu odamlarga xiyonatdan qo'rqmasdan eng chuqur qo'rquv va intilishlarini baham ko'rishga imkon beradi. Aslida, u "xavfsiz boshpana" yaratadi va beqaror dunyoda chuqur psixologik xavfsizlikni ta'minlaydi.

questions.prompt: People today read fewer books than before.
questions.sampleA1: Yes, people don't read books. They watch phone. Phone is easy.
questions.sampleA2: I think people read less books now. They prefer playing games or watching videos on the internet. Reading is hard work.
questions.sampleB1: It is true that many people spend a lot of time on social media instead of reading books. Because of this, they might read fewer printed books. However, people still read a lot on their phones and computers, like news and articles. So maybe they don't read less, they just read differently.
questions.sampleB2: This is a really interesting claim, and honestly, I can see where it comes from. On the one hand, there's a lot of truth to it. These days, most people are glued to their phones, scrolling through social media or watching short videos, and all of that eats into the time they might once have spent with a book. Let's face it, reading a whole novel takes a fair amount of patience and concentration, and in our fast-paced world, a lot of people simply go for the instant gratification of a quick video instead. On the other hand, I'd argue that reading hasn't so much declined as changed shape. Sure, fewer people might be curling up with a paper book, but millions are reading e-books, online articles and blogs every single day. When you add up all the texting, news apps and web pages people get through, you could argue we're actually reading more than ever — just not in the traditional sense. As for where I stand, I have to say I lean towards the more optimistic view. To my mind, the medium has shifted rather than the habit dying out altogether. That said, I do think we've lost something valuable, because scrolling doesn't quite give you the same deep, immersive experience as losing yourself in a good novel. At the end of the day, I reckon we should make a conscious effort to pick up a physical book now and then, otherwise deep reading really could become a dying art.

for: Many prefer social media and videos.
against: Some people still enjoy reading regularly.

questions.sampleAnswer:
The assertion that people today read less than previous generations is a topic of considerable debate. Many argue that traditional book reading is indeed declining. They point out that modern technology, especially social media and short-form videos, relentlessly distracts individuals. Since reading a novel demands sustained concentration—a dwindling asset in our fast-paced era—many opt for the "instant gratification" provided by a quick video scroll.
Conversely, opponents argue that the format has simply evolved rather than disappeared. While physical book sales might fluctuate, millions actively consume texts via e-books, blogs, and online articles. Furthermore, unprecedented access to educational materials on the internet means people are arguably reading a vast amount of information daily, just not in the traditional bound formats.
In conclusion, while the medium has drastically shifted towards digital screens, human consumption of the written word remains robust. People haven't stopped reading; they have merely adapted to modern digital paradigms.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bugungi kunda odamlar avvalgi avlodlarga nisbatan kamroq kitob o'qishi haqidagi da'vo jiddiy bahs mavzusi hisoblanadi. Ko'pchilik an'anaviy kitob o'qish haqiqatan ham kamayib borayotganini ta'kidlaydi. Ular zamonaviy texnologiyalar, ayniqsa ijtimoiy media va qisqa metrajli videolar odamlarni tinimsiz chalg'itishini aytishadi. Roman o'qish uzoq muddatli diqqatni talab qilganligi sababli – bizning tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanayotgan davrimizda kamayib borayotgan boylik – ko'pchilik tezkor video tomosha qilish orqali taqdim etiladigan "bir zumda qoniqish"ni tanlaydi.

Aksincha, opponentlar format yo'qolgan emas, balki shunchaki rivojlangan deb ta'kidlaydi. Jismoniy kitoblar savdosi o'zgarib turishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, millionlab odamlar elektron kitoblar, bloglar va onlayn maqolalar orqali matnlarni faol ravishda iste'mol qilmoqda. Bundan tashqari, internetda ta'lim materiallariga misli ko'rilmagan darajada kirish imkoniyati odamlar har kuni juda ko'p ma'lumot o'qiyotganini anglatadi, faqat an'anaviy muqovali formatlarda emas.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, vosita raqamli ekranlarga keskin o'zgargan bo'lsa-da, insonning yozma so'zni iste'mol qilish hajmi barqarorligicha qolmoqda. Odamlar o'qishni to'xtatgani yo'q; ular shunchaki zamonaviy raqamli paradigmalariga moslashdi.
